attributes.board_name: Idaho Physical Therapy Licensure Board (Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Areas of study germane to the practice of physical therapy, with a certificate of completion or transcript. Prior Board approval of CE offerings is no longer needed (DOPL notice of 7/26/2024).
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation verifying attendance (instructor/provider signatures or other proof) and provide it on request of the Board or its agent.
rules.notes: Applies to every license issued by the Board (PT and PTA). Idaho moved from 1-year to 2-year licenses from October 14, 2025: licensees born in odd years got 2-year licenses from their 2025 renewal, those born in even years from 2026; licenses expire on the licensee's birthday and the fee covers two years. CE requirement unchanged by the transition. Reinstatement: 16 hours if expired 3 years or less, 32 hours if longer. No mandatory topics.
